68.stemOverride: The \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}}\) of \(\text{Cu}_{(s)} \mid \text{Cu}^{2+}_{(1\,M)} \parallel \text{Ag}^{+}_{(1\,M)} \mid \text{Ag}_{(s)}\) is 0.647 volt. Calculate the \(E^\circ_{\text{Ag}}\) if \(E^\circ_{\text{Cu}}\) is 0.153 V.
68.solution: Copper is the anode and silver the cathode, so \(E^\circ_{\text{cell}} = E^\circ_{\text{Ag}} - E^\circ_{\text{Cu}}\). Then \(E^\circ_{\text{Ag}} = 0.647 + 0.153 = 0.800\) V. Option A.

69.solution: A conjugate acid has one more proton than its base. \(\text{NH}_2^-\) gains a proton to give \(\text{NH}_3\), and \(\text{NH}_3\) gains one to give \(\text{NH}_4^+\). Option C.
